title: Scene graph (verifier's view)
description: The minimal view of the live scene the Verification and Policy Layer needs. It is the state the orchestrator holds; planners never produce it. The Scene DSL owner (compiler/renderer) may carry richer properties, but every field here must agree with the compiler's representation.

scene_version.description: Monotonic version. A proposal must name the version it was generated against.

topic.description: Must be one of the bounded topics in contracts/topics.json.

nodes.description: Known lesson-graph node IDs. Return anchors must name one of these.

objects.description: Scene objects keyed by object ID. The deterministic hit-test returns these IDs.

expression.description: For curves: the function expression in the variable `var`.

origin.description: Objects created in an explanation branch may be removed; base-lesson objects may not.

source_refs.description: Approved source references available to this lesson.
